name: 便签鸭黄
description: 便利贴手写感：鸭黄底 #FFF8B8 + 橙红 #FF6B35 + 棕字 + Caveat 手写字体。H1 大字随意、H2 橙色手写、blockquote 像便条手写附注、wrapper 带单边阴影模拟翘角贴纸。轻快随性独一份（vs pastel 柔紫圆润）。适合备忘录/灵感手记/吐槽/轻快评论。

styles.container: background-color: #FFF8B8; font-family: 'Caveat','Marker Felt','Comic Sans MS','Hiragino Sans GB','PingFang SC',cursive; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.10);
styles.h1: font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; color: #4A3628; text-align: left; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 22px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 3px wavy #FF6B35; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: 'Caveat','Marker Felt',cursive; transform: rotate(-0.5deg);
styles.h2: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #FF6B35; line-height: 1.25; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 14px; font-family: 'Caveat','Marker Felt',cursive;
styles.h3: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: #4A3628; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 14px; border-left: 4px solid #FF6B35; font-family: 'Caveat','Marker Felt',cursive;
styles.h4: font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: #FF6B35; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-style: italic; font-family: 'Caveat',cursive;
styles.h5: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #6A5238; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.4; font-family: 'Caveat',cursive;
styles.h6: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #8A7656; margin-top: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.4; font-family: 'Caveat',cursive;
styles.p: font-size: 17px; color: #4A3628; line-height: 1.7; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.blockquote: background: #FFFAD4; border: 2px dashed #FF6B35; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 18px; color: #6A5238; line-height: 1.65; transform: rotate(-0.3deg); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 18px; color: #6A5238; line-height: 1.65; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent;
styles.a: color: #FF6B35; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-style: wavy; text-underline-offset: 3px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; border: 3px solid #4A3628; background: transparent; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #FF6B35; transform: rotate(-1deg);
styles.hr: margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px; height: 0; border: none; border-top: 3px dashed #FF6B35; width: 60%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
styles.code: background: #FFE8C0; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 16px; color: #4A3628; font-family: 'Caveat','Marker Felt',cursive; font-weight: 600;
styles.pre: background: #FFFAD4; border: 2px solid #4A3628; border-radius: 6px; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #FF6B35; color: #4A3628; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; background: #FF6B35; color: #FFF8B8; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Caveat',cursive;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #4A3628; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 16px; border: 2px solid #4A3628;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #FFF8B8; background: #FF6B35; font-size: 17px;
styles.li: font-size: 19px; color: #4A3628; line-height: 1.7; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
